description: This file defines the CDPSessionDispatcher class which manages a Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) session, handling communication and lifecycle events related to a CDPSession object within the Playwright project.

classes.name: CDPSessionDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for managing a CDPSession, facilitating message sending, event dispatching, and cleanup.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the dispatcher with a scope (BrowserDispatcher or BrowserContextDispatcher) and a CDPSession object, sets up event listeners.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command over the CDP session, returning the result, with support for progress reporting.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the CDP session, marking the progress metadata to indicate scope potential closure.

ctags.name: CDPSessionDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class CDPSessionDispatcher extends Dispatcher<CDPSession, channels.CDPSessionChannel, Bro/
